doc_title_jp: 業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績予想の上方修正（営業利益、経常利益の大幅増）、自己株式取得及び消却による総合的な株主還元策、財務状況等を勘案

summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 51 yen/share (from 36 yen); year-end dividend raised to 93 yen/share (from 86 yen). Full-year payout ratio including buyback and cancellation 62.6%. Dividend policy: progressive payouts targeting 40%+ consolidated payout ratio. Stock split 1:4 effective 1 October 2026.
summary_jp: 中間配当51円/株（前36円）、期末配当93円/株（前86円）に増配。自社株買収・消却含む総還元性向62.6%。配当方針：40%以上の連結総還元性向を目標に累進配当。10月1日に1:4株式分割予定。
tag_en: Dividend hike - FY3/27: interim 51 yen/share (vs 36 yen prior), year-end 93 yen/share (vs 86 yen prior) - payout ratio 62.6% including buyback
